summary: Klamath County steel Aermotor lookout built by the Klamath Forest Protective Association around 1930-31, staffed into the 1970s and still standing on a 2020 visit.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor LS-40 tower with a 7 x 7 steel cab, plus a residence cabin added in 1936
facts.status_note: Last used regularly in the 1970s; an old lookout was still there on a July 2020 visit.

visit.trail_note: A July 2020 visitor found the main access road a rutted 4WD route of about three or four miles and suggested walking up instead of driving.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says the tower was constructed in 1930; firelookout.com says it was built in 1931. A road to the summit was completed in June 1930, which fits either date. Both kept as events.
NHLR gives a 21-foot tower; firelookout.com gives a 26-foot steel tower. The record's 7.9 m (26 ft) is kept; NHLR's figure would be about 6.4 m.
NHLR says staffed into the 1970s; firelookout.com says last used regularly in the 1970s. No source gives an exact final year.

notes_for_editor: Access is not established: no fetched source names the land owner or says whether the site is open to visitors, so no access key is given. The only firsthand account is the July 2020 PNW SOTA report. Search results describing a 9-mile rough road and a 1.25-mile hike were not fetched and are not used. The 1970 staffed_last year is a placeholder for 'into the 1970s'. A 1915 telephone line and 1924-1925 lookout entries also appear on the Forest Lookouts page and were not used.
